name: Affordable Conveyor Services LLC

about:
Affordable Conveyor Services LLC is based in Southington, Connecticut, and was founded in 2006. The company is owned and managed by Philip J. Robotham Jr., who brings more than 30 years of hands‑on experience in the conveyor industry. The business was built on a combined 60 years of expertise in installation, repair, and maintenance of conveyor systems.

The firm provides end‑to‑end conveyor system solutions, including complete installation, preventative maintenance programs, emergency and routine repairs, safety inspections, system audits, replacements, upgrades, and removal or relocation of equipment. Specialty services cover vertical reciprocating conveyors, stretch‑wrap and band‑strapping machines, mezzanines, racking, shelving, crane and hoist systems, baggage handling, parcel conveyors, pharmaceutical and food‑grade conveyors, garment conveyors, and unit handling systems. Engineering support encompasses site supervision, project management, technical troubleshooting, controls and electrical repairs, pneumatic piping, and system modifications. A 24/7 emergency response is available nationwide.

The company serves distribution centers, retail fulfillment and warehousing operations, packaging and shipping centers, pharmaceutical manufacturers, airports and baggage handling facilities, and food and beverage processing plants.

Affordable Conveyor Services emphasizes competitiveness and attention to quality workmanship that exceeds customer expectations, leveraging experience across all conveyor types to deliver cost‑effective solutions.
